items.summary: In Slip Op. 26-70 (Court No. 24-00119, filed July 1, 2026), Judge Joseph A. Laroski of the U.S. Court of International Trade granted the plaintiffs' motion for judgment on the agency record in a challenge by the American Brass Rod Fair Trade Coalition and its Individual Members. The court remanded the U.S. Department of Commerce's final affirmative determination in the less-than-fair-value investigation of brass rod from India, published at 89 Fed. Reg. 29,300, for further consideration and explanation of cost-of-manufacturing adjustments for respondent Rajhans Metals Private Limited, including work-in-progress inventory and scrap offsets. The opinion states that the court agrees with the plaintiffs on these issues.

items.summary: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations to require the verification of U.S. citizenship or the eligible immigration status of all applicants and recipients of assistance under a covered program regardless of age. The rule will also make prorated assistance a temporary condition pending verification of eligible status of all family members, where permitted by statute, as opposed to under HUD's current regulations where prorated assistance could continue indefinitely. These amendments bring HUD's regulations into greater alignment with the wording and purpose of Section 214 and align with the current Administration's priorities and regulatory reform efforts.

items.summary: The FAA is superseding Airworthiness Directive (AD) 2022-20-11, which applied to certain Bell Textron Canada Limited Model 429 helicopters. AD 2022-20-11 required visually inspecting the external surface of the tail rotor (TR) gearbox support assembly, borescope inspecting or visually inspecting the inside of the tail boom, and performing a tactile inspection. Depending on the results of the inspections, AD 2022-20-11 required removing certain rivets from service or repairing gaps in accordance with an approved method. Since the FAA issued AD 2022-20-11, the manufacturer determined the repetitive inspection interval needs to be reduced. This AD requires the same actions as AD 2022-20-11 and reduces the inspection interval. The FAA is issuing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

If implemented, this proposed rule would establish a shrimp fishery access area (SFAA) along the eastern boundary of the northern extension of the Oculina Bank Habitat Area of Particular Concern (OHAPC) where trawling for rock shrimp is currently prohibited. The purpose of this proposed rule is to reinstate access to historic rock shrimp fishing grounds, achieve optimum yield (OY) in the rock shrimp fishery, while minimizing impacts to deep-water corals in the OHAPC.

items.summary: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA or Department) proposes to amend the regulations governing grazing and livestock use on the National Forest System to modernize grazing administration, improve clarity, codify existing policy, and expand opportunities for stewardship and access. items.summary: In this document, the Federal Communications Commission (Commission) repeals the national television multiple ownership rule (national cap), which prohibits a commercial television licensee from having a cognizable interest in television stations that have an aggregate national audience reach above 39%. items.opening_verbatim: POSTAL SERVICE 39 CFR Part 501 Authorization To Manufacture and Distribute Postage Evidencing Systems AGENCY: Postal Service. ACTION: Proposed rule. SUMMARY: The Postal Service is amending its Postage Evidencing Systems regulations to align
items.summary: The Postal Service is amending its Postage Evidencing Systems regulations to align with existing practices and operational realities to better address circumstances where advances by a resetting company on any given day exceed the daily average funds advanced amount maintained on deposit with the Postal Service. The regulations currently allow resetting companies to advance postage to customers by a process where the resetting company maintains a daily average advance balance with the Postal Service. The current regulation contemplates that the amount on deposit will always cover amounts advanced and does not permit a resetting company to advance funds to customers in excess of the amount maintained on deposit. Operational realities will create circumstances where it is necessary to advance funds in excess of the amount on deposit and the average daily balance rule represents a practical and fair method to address circumstances where excess advances occur.
items.title: Authorization To Manufacture and Distribute Postage Evidencing Systems

items.summary: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for all Diamond Aircraft Industries GmbH (DAI) Model DA 50 C airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by reports of flap actuator failures. This proposed AD would require inspecting for displacement of the black slide grommet and inspecting the rod end bearing for a tight fit of the flap actuator.
